title: Neon Pursuit
prompt: dance pop euro pop, uk garage, fast and high energy
description: A blazing 134 BPM europop sprint built around a square-wave hook that punches through neon-lit layers of LinnDrum percussion and a snarling filtered bassline. The track peaks early with full energy, then deconstructs into a hypnotic stripped groove before rebuilding for a euphoric finish. Offbeat hats, a breathing LFO bass, and octave echo effects give it the kinetic pulse of classic UK garage.
